name: rehydrate
description: Lets Codex recover and recheck session-wide continuity during execution.

interface.shortDescription: Recover and recheck context during active work.
interface.longDescription: Rehydrate activates after context compaction, builds a bounded structural history index, and expands only selected user turns, call/result pairs, and async continuations. It recovers the final meaningful pre-compaction segment and whole-session trajectory, and requires matching earlier evidence before the first retry or workaround after a material failure.
defaultPrompt: Use $rehydrate:rehydrate to recover context with a bounded structural index and targeted evidence expansion.
Recover the session details needed to continue without repeating or contradicting prior work.
